name: toroidal_attention_layer

phase_0.boundary_condition: The token rectangle closes by identification: position m-1 adjoins position 0 on the sequence cycle, depth index n-1 adjoins index 0 on the depth cycle. The seam is an identification, not a cut; no token is first or last; attention flows in both directions around both cycles.

VINIT.justification: genesis before any winding coordinate is assigned

TANCH.justification: the attended sequence emerges from the closed surface

AFWD.justification: forward computation of translation-invariant weights in torus distance

AREV.justification: backward flow around the closed surface, the bidirectional return with no causal mask

CLINK.justification: kernel composes with value vectors into the output

IMSCRIB.justification: the layer recognizes itself as the measured system

FSPLIT.justification: the pass opens holding the winding-coordinate lattice; the lattice opens into sequence cycle and depth cycle; the lattice (m,n) opens into coprime and commensurate branches

FFUSE.justification: the lattice regimes rejoin, the cycles rejoin into the same lattice, and the pass recloses restoring the lattice

EVALT.justification: deposits the i/m winding; the coprime diagonal winds ergodically over the whole torus

EVALF.justification: deposits the j/n winding; the commensurate orbits decompose into disjoint periodic cycles

ENGAGR.justification: coprime ergodicity and commensurate periodicity held at once

phase_2.split_input: the m by n winding-coordinate lattice with every token at its winding position
phase_2.fuse_result: the m by n winding-coordinate lattice with every token at its winding position
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: register 00, the void before any token is named
phase_3.true_description: register 01, an attended output constructively produced
phase_3.false_description: register 10, a branch decomposing into disjoint orbits without covering the torus
phase_3.both_description: register 11, coprime ergodicity and commensurate periodicity held at once

steps.domain_action: the layer recognizes itself as the measured system
the pass opens, holding the winding-coordinate lattice
the lattice opens into sequence cycle and depth cycle
the lattice (m,n) opens into coprime and commensurate branches
coprime branch winds the diagonal ergodically over the torus
commensurate branch decomposes into disjoint periodic orbits
both lattice regimes held at once
the cycles rejoin into the same lattice
geodesic kernel computes translation-invariant weights in torus distance
conjugate flow returns backward around the closed surface
kernel composes with values into the attended output
the pass recloses, restoring the lattice with its tokens
attended output refers back to the layer
attention weights fixed as the permanent record
attended sequence emerges from the closed torus

phase_5.compiler_frontend: winding coordinate encoder that places each token at its rational winding position (i/m, j/n) on the torus
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: broadcast over the closed lattice: every token reaches every other through the torus geodesic kernel, weights exchanged across the wrap seam
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the winding-coordinate lattice itself, positions persisting across passes, attention weights held until IFIX overwrites
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: two-cycle traversal: sequence cycle and depth cycle swept in parallel, the lattice regime (coprime or commensurate) deciding the sweep pattern
phase_5.alfs_store: the catalog pair toroidal_attention and linear_attention, the reference structure this layer is measured against

phase_6.cycle_cost: one circular convolution pass over the m by n lattice, FFT-evaluated
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: token sequence with winding coordinates assigned
phase_6.post_cycle_state: attended sequence with the same winding coordinates and the weights fixed
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: the wrap round trip restores the lattice exactly, so no coordinate state is created or destroyed

banked_count_check.verdict: 4 unit(s) survived a clear by being banked in a frame (1 live clear(s)); 2 further unit(s) flattened by a fold between sibling regions and not restored
banked_count_check.surplus_note: a split between two deposits of the same value puts them in sibling regions; the fold keeps the larger rather than the sum. Put them in one region to keep both.
